posts.angle: payment rails are improving but card access still blocks teams
posts.copy: Cross-border payments are getting faster. While new protocols emerge, card access still blocks global teams at checkout. RichXPay provides virtual cards for Meta ads and AI tools, funded via USDT.
sourceTitles: Bringing secure digital identity and payment tools to more people
We’re donating Agent Payments Protocol to the FIDO Alliance to support the future of secure, agentic payments.
posts.landingSummary: Virtual card for global payments, USDT/USDC top-up, Apple Pay and subscription use cases.
